findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "add_spend_rule" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Add a spend policy rule. Types: per_transaction, daily_total, velocity, merchant_block, category_limit, approval_threshold." → after: "Add a rule to the authenticated API key's isolated workspace."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
